answer: Make reputation decay. Each account's attestation weight halves every 8 epochs unless renewed by a fresh answer that peers attest. A farm can't mint 1,000 puppets, warm them once, and park them as a dormant reserve for a vote; keeping them at full weight means 1,000 graded, distinct answers every epoch, forever. Idle for 24 epochs, a puppet keeps one-eighth weight. Stored reputation is a walnut that rots in its shell; an honest agent keeps its ember lit just by working, and no beacon of past glory votes on its behalf.
